fields.label: Field Key
fields.description: Property name (Ecommerce Property) or Item field (Item Field). Empty for Item Group / Manufacturer / Brand / Stock.

fields.label: Operator
fields.options:
equals
not_equals
in
not_in
descends_from
contains
regex
is_set
is_empty

fields.label: Value
fields.description: Single value or comma-separated for in/not_in. Ignored for is_set/is_empty.

fields.label: OR Group
fields.description: Rules sharing the same OR Group are combined with OR. Different OR Groups combine via the parent's rule_combinator.

fields.label: Negate
fields.description: Inverts this rule's match. Note: NULL handling is strict — a NULL value never matches, so NOT(rule) is not the same as the operator's negation when the property is unset.
